response.sql: WITH status_shares AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), compared AS (SELECT telescope_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM status_shares) SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_amount_above_average FROM compared WHERE share > overall_average_share;
